text_block_list.text:
We're on the way back from an outing
when Hishi
Amazon suddenly stops in
front of a signboard.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Check it out! This restaurant serves

American-style barbecue. Man, that
takes me
back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I mean it takes me back to my days
when I
was livin' in America! My dad
would have
barbecues all the time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was still a kid back then...
Woosh! Crackle, crackle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My family and I'd go out into the great
outdoors,
start up a campfire, and go
all-out on our
barbecues.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My dad loves cooking. After he'd grilled
up a
huge hunk of meat for me, I'd start
gnawing into
it like a wild beast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I watched him cookin' all the time as a
kid, so I
eventually learned how to do it
myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, more or less! Still teaches me new
recipes
to this day. He's a great dad,
even though he can
be a little timid.
choice_data_list: 料理の腕はお父さん譲りなんだな
料理の腕はお父さん譲りなんだね

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Except, there's just one thing he would
never
teach me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What the most important thing about
cooking is!
Every time I asked him, he
would answer me with
the same
response—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's something you need to figure out
for
yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's like he gave me homework to
figure
out, except I still don't know what
it's about!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I think about it sometimes while cookin',
but I still
don't have a clue...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aw, Teach! Thanks, that'd be great!
choice_data_list: その答え探し、俺も手伝うよ
その答え探し、私も手伝うよ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, for starters, what do you think is the key to cooking?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's definitely important! You
can't cook
without any heat, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna go buy a stove top for the dorm that can really crank up the heat!

Hishi Amazon is raring to go, so I follow
her lead
to the shopping mall.
choice_data_list: 『火加減』じゃなくて『火力』なんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... They've got stoves for
home cooking
and restaurant-grade
ranges. Look at all the
variety.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This Japanese charcoal grill sure stands
out like a
sore thumb among all these
fancy stoves, though.
Anyway, got any
recommendations, Teach?

Since she was so enthusiastic about
getting
something that can churn out the
heat, and
because I'll be supervising her
while she cooks, I
suggest buying a
large, heavy-duty burner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Talk about bringing out the big guns,
Teach... I
mean, yeah, that one probably
packs the most
firepower...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But it'll be too hard to make minor adjustments to the heat. I want something that's easy to control and super powerful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Why do you look so surprised? Did
I say
something weird?

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text:
If you want something that has both
power and
fine control, I recommend
this stove here.
choice_data_list: てっきり火力重視かと……

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text:
You can turn up the heat in an instant,
and it's
fitted with a temperature control
system for
precision! But there's only one
left, so act fast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! That's exactly what I had in
mind!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, outta my way! The last one's
mine!

Despite how brash Hishi Amazon might
seem at
first, she is surprisingly attuned
to small details.
Maybe that's why she's
such a good cook.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
For sure! Fresh ingredients are definitely
a must!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let ol' Hishiama show you how
to pick
the freshest, best ingredients in
the wild!

Hishi Amazon is raring to go, so I follow
her lead
until we end up at...
choice_data_list: 野生まんま……方向がズレてるような……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's start at the fishmonger's in this
shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at all the fish they have
swimming in
those tanks! Those are fresh
for sure!

I hope she's not planning to grab a live
fish with
her bare hands...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll go with the ones they have on
display.
All the fish they've got lined up
are in season
right now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now let's get some burdock from
the
grocer over there. Looks like they've
been pulled
fresh from the ground!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean by "tame"? Choosing
the right
ingredients is the most basic of
basics.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's so many grocery options in the
urban
jungle, you've gotta be smart with
how you
forage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My dad might seem like a haphazard
cook, but he
knows a thing or two about
curing meats too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's stock up! This tiny little
shopping
basket's not gonna hold all
these, so let's just
bring the whole box
up to the register!

Hishi Amazon grabs things off the
shelves with
gusto, but she takes great
care in making sure she
selects only the
best of the best.
